            pts.append([x, y])

        centers = centers + jitter_rng.uniform(-jitter, jitter, centers.shape)

    patterns summing to 26 plus deterministic jittered variants) are
    scored with the exact LP radius allocation; the top few are polished
    by LP-scored coordinate descent, then bounded basin hopping perturbs
    the best layout and re-polishes. A hard deadline keeps runtime well
    inside the limit. Returns (centers, radii, sum_of_radii).

        [5, 6, 5, 6, 4],
        [4, 6, 6, 6, 4],
        [5, 5, 6, 5, 5],
        [6, 4, 6, 4, 6],
        [5, 4, 6, 6, 5],
        [7, 6, 7, 6],

            candidates.append(_grid_layout(pattern, rng, 0.03))

        r = compute_max_radii(c)
        scored.append((float(np.sum(r)), c))
    scored.sort(key=lambda t: -t[0])

    deadline = time.time() + 280.0

        c = c.copy()
        radii = compute_max_radii(c)
        for _ in range(2):
            c, radii = refine_centers(c, radii)
            radii = compute_max_radii(c)

        if best is None or np.sum(radii) > best[0]:
            best = (float(np.sum(radii)), c, radii)

            break

            best[1] + rng.uniform(-0.02, 0.02, best[1].shape), 0.02, 0.98

            radii = compute_max_radii(pert)

            pert, max_sweeps=15, deadline=deadline

    sum_radii, centers, radii = best
    return centers, radii, sum_radii

                      deadline=None):

    Coordinate descent on centers where every trial move is scored by the
    exact LP sum of radii for the whole layout. A move is accepted only
    if the total LP sum strictly increases, so we climb the true
    objective rather than a per-circle proxy. Step shrinks geometrically;
    sweeps stop early at the deadline.
